sentences.text: A hungry fox walks through a sunny garden.

translations.en: A hungry fox walks through a sunny garden.
translations.fr: Un renard affamé marche dans un jardin ensoleillé.
translations.es: Un zorro hambriento camina por un jardín soleado.

sentences.text: He looks everywhere for food to eat.

translations.en: He looks everywhere for food to eat.
translations.fr: Il cherche partout de la nourriture à manger.
translations.es: Busca comida por todas partes para comer.

sentences.text: Then he looks up at a tall wooden vine.

translations.en: Then he looks up at a tall wooden vine.
translations.fr: Puis il lève les yeux vers une haute vigne en bois.
translations.es: Luego mira hacia arriba a una alta parra de madera.

sentences.text: He sees many sweet purple grapes hanging high.

translations.en: He sees many sweet purple grapes hanging high.
translations.fr: Il voit beaucoup de raisins violets sucrés suspendus haut.
translations.es: Ve muchas uvas moradas dulces colgando en lo alto.

sentences.text: The ripe grapes look very juicy and fresh.

translations.en: The ripe grapes look very juicy and fresh.
translations.fr: Les raisins mûrs ont l'air très juteux et frais.
translations.es: Las uvas maduras se ven muy jugosas y frescas.

sentences.text: The fox wants the grapes very much.

translations.en: The fox wants the grapes very much.
translations.fr: Le renard veut beaucoup les raisins.
translations.es: El zorro desea mucho las uvas.

translations.fr: L'eau lui vient à la bouche avec envie.
translations.es: Se le hace la boca agua de deseo.

sentences.text: The fox takes a step back.

translations.en: The fox takes a step back.
translations.fr: Le renard fait un pas en arrière.
translations.es: El zorro da un paso atrás.

sentences.text: He jumps high into the air.

translations.en: He jumps high into the air.
translations.fr: Il saute haut dans les airs.

sentences.text: But he misses the sweet purple fruit.

translations.en: But he misses the sweet purple fruit.
translations.fr: Mais il manque le fruit doux et violet.
translations.es: Pero falla el dulce fruto morado.

sentences.text: He tries again and jumps higher.

translations.en: He tries again and jumps higher.
translations.fr: Il réessaie et saute plus haut.
translations.es: Intenta de nuevo y salta más alto.

sentences.text: Still he cannot touch the grapes.

translations.en: Still he cannot touch the grapes.
translations.fr: Pourtant, il ne peut toujours pas toucher les raisins.
translations.es: Aún no puede tocar las uvas.

sentences.text: The tired fox gives up at last.

translations.en: The tired fox gives up at last.
translations.es: El zorro cansado se rinde por fin.

sentences.text: He turns his head and walks away.

translations.en: He turns his head and walks away.
translations.fr: Il tourne la tête et s'en va.
translations.es: Gira la cabeza y se aleja caminando.

sentences.text: He says that the grapes are sour anyway.

translations.en: He says that the grapes are sour anyway.
translations.fr: Il dit que les raisins sont verts de toute façon.
translations.es: Dice que las uvas están agrias de todos modos.

sentences.text: It is easy to dislike what you cannot have.

translations.en: It is easy to dislike what you cannot have.
translations.fr: Il est facile de mépriser ce que l'on ne peut pas avoir.
translations.es: Es fácil despreciar lo que no se puede tener.
